O.N. 35.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Himachal Pradesh, 2022 for 
27-Sundernagar Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India vide 
Notification No. 464/HP-LA/2023, dated 17" October, 2022; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 27-Sundernagar Assembly Constituency of Himachal 
Pradesh, 2022 was declared by the Returning Officer on 08 December, 2022 and hence the last date for lodging 
the account of Election Expenses was 07" January, 2023; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report no. ELN-MND-F(2)-1/2022-1-93 dated 10-01-2023 of the DEO, Mandi 
under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Shri Het Ram, a contesting candidate from 
27-Sundernagar Assembly Constituency of Himachal Pradesh, 2022 has failed to lodge account of election 
expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/HP-LA/27/2023/CEMS-I, dated 120 July, 2023 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Shri Het Ram, for not lodging of account of Election 
Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961, Shri Het Ram, was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Mandi District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Himachal Pradesh vide letter no. 3-7\2023-ELN-EEM-III 
dated 08.08.2023 forwarded the District Election Officer, Mandi Distt., vide his letter no. ELN-MND-F(2)- 
1/2022-1-1594 Mandi-175001 dated 07-08-2023 has reported that the said notice was served to Shri Het Ram, 
on 01.08.2023; and 


WHEREAS, the CEO, Himachal Pradesh vide letter no 3-7\2023-ELN-EEM-III-1361, dated 
19.09.2023 forwarded the District Election Officer, Mandi Supplementary Report No . ELN-MND-F(2)-1/2022- 
1-1819 dated 25.08.2022 and reported that Shri Het Ram has not submitted account of election expenses. Further, 
after receipt of the said notice, Shri Het Ram, has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election 
Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and

WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by 
or under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 
and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Shri Het Ram, 
has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Shri Het Ram, Vill.-Mahwra, P.O.Seri Kothi, Teh.- 
Sundernagar, Distt. Mandi, Himachal Pradesh and a contesting candidate in 27-Sundernagar Assembly 
Constituency of General Election to the Legislative Assembly of Himachal Pradesh, 2022, to be disqualified for 
being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the 
Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.

New Delhi, the 29th January, 2024 


O.N. 37.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Himachal Pradesh, 2022 for 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India vide Notification No. 464/HP- 
LA/2023, dated 177 October, 2022; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


88 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : FEBRUARY 10, 2024/MAGHA 21, 1945 [PART II—SEc. 3(iii)] 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 33-Mandi Assembly Constituency of Himachal Pradesh, 2022 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 08 December, 2022 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 07" January, 2023; and 

WHEREAS, as per the report no. ELN-MND-F(2)-1/2022-1-93 dated 10-01-2023 of the DEO, Mandi 
under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Shri Sanjay Kumar, a contesting candidate 
from 33-Mandi Assembly Constituency of Himachal Pradesh, has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as 
required under law; and 

WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/HP-LA/27/2023/CEMS-I, dated 12" July, 2023 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Shri Sanjay Kumar, for not lodging of account of 
Election Expenses; and 

WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961, Shri Sanjay Kumar, was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Mandi District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 

WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Himachal Pradesh vide letter no. 3-7\2023-ELN-EEM-III 
dated 08.08.2023 forwarded the District Election Officer, Mandi Distt., vide his letter no. ELN-MND-F(2)- 
1/2022-1-1594 Mandi-175001 dated 07-08-2023 has reported that the said notice was served to Shri Sanjay 
Kumar, on 26.07.2023; and 

WHEREAS, the CEO, Himachal Pradesh vide letter no 3-7\2023-ELN-EEM-III-1361, dated 
19.09.2023 forwarded the District Election Officer, Mandi Supplementary Report No Elec.2022/5234dated 
08.07.2022 and reported that Shri Sanjay Kumar has not submitted account of election expenses. Further, after 
receipt of the said notice, Shri Sanjay Kumar, has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election 
Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and 

WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or 

under this Act, and 

(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 
and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 

WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Shri Sanjay 
Kumar, has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do 
so; and 

NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Shri Sanjay Kumar, Vill.-Kathyana, P.O.Bir Tungal, Teh.-Sadar, 
Distt. Mandi, Himachal Pradesh-175001 and a contesting candidate in 33-Mandi Assembly Constituency of 
General Election to the Legislative Assembly of Himachal Pradesh, 2022, to be disqualified for being chosen as 
and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of 
a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 29th January, 2024 


O.N. 38.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Punjab, 2022 106-Amargarh 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India vide Notification No. 464/PB- 
LA/2022, dated 25" January, 2022; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 106-Amargarh Assembly Constituency of Punjab, 2022 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 107 March, 2022 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 09" April, 2022; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report no. Elec. 2022/R-8510, dated 26.04.2022 of the Chief Electoral Officer, 
Punjab under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, received, Shri Satvir Singh Sheera 
Banbhaura, a contesting candidate from 106-Amargarh Assembly Constituency of Punjab, 2022 has failed to 
lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/PB-LA/106/2022/CEMS-I, dated 27" June, 2022 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Shri Satvir Singh Sheera Banbhaura, for not 
lodging of account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Shri Satvir Singh Sheera Banbhaura, was directed to submit representation in writing to 
the Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses 
with the District Election Officer, Malerkotla District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec.2023/R-3550 dated 21.06.2023 
forwarded the report of the District Election Officer, Malerkotla dated 07.09.2022 wherein it was informed that 
notice was served to Shri Satvir Singh Sheera Banbhaura, dated 07 July, 2022; and 


WHEREAS, the CEO, Punjab vide letter no ELEC-2023/R-3550, dated 21.06.2023 forwarded the District 
Election Officer, Malerkotla Supplementary Report dated 31.08.2022 and reported that Shri Satvir Singh Sheera 
Banbhaura, has not submitted account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Shri Satvir 
Singh Sheera Banbhaura, has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, 
for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 


WD, 


and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Shri Satvir Singh 
Sheera Banbhaura, has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the 
failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Shri Satvir Singh Sheera Banbhaura, Vill. Banbhaura,Tehsil- 
Amargarh,Distt. Malerkotla and a contesting candidate in 106-Amargarh Assembly Constituency of General 
Election to the Legislative Assembly of Punjab, 2022, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member 
of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union 
Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order. 


[No. 76/PB-LA/106/2022/CEMS-I] 
By Order,

O.N. 40.—WHEREAS, the General Election to 377-Zahoorabad Legislative Assembly of Uttar Pradesh, 


2022 was announced vide Notification No. 99/61-2022 dated 10" February, 2022. 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election has to, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge a true copy of the 
account of his election expenses with the District Election Officer; and, 

WHEREAS, the result of the said election along with 377-Zahoorabad Assembly Constituency was 
declared by the concerned Returning Officer on 10" March, 2022. Hence, the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 09" April, 2022; and, 

WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by the District Election Officer, Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh and 
forwarded by the Joint Chief Electoral Officer, Uttar Pradesh vide their letter No. 287/NirvachanVayy Cell/GE- 
LA/2022/Patra-01/2021, dated 27" April, 2022, Shri Arvind, a contesting candidate of Uttar Pradesh from 377- 
Zahoorabad Assembly Constituency of Uttar Pradesh, has failed to lodge account of his election expenses, in the 
manner, as required under law; and, 

WHEREAS, on the basis of the reports of the District Election Officer, Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh and the 
Chief Electoral Officer, Uttar Pradesh, a Show-Cause notice,76/UP-LA/2022/CEMS-III dated 23.11.2022 was 
issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to 
Shri Arvind for not lodging the account of Election Expenses; and, 

WHEREAS, As per the sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, through the above 
said Show-Cause Notice, dated 23.11.2022 Shri Arvind was directed to submit his representation in writing with 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and to lodge account of election expenses within 20 days from the 
date of receipt of the notice; and, 

WHEREAS, the said notice was received by Sh. Mukesh Kumar, Nephew of the candidate on 22.12.2022. 
The acknowledgment receipt has been submitted to the Commission by the District Election Officer, Ghazipur vide 


its letter no. 432/निर्वाचन-नोटिस तामिला/1104०0 20.07.2023 and, 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Ghazipur in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter No. 
685/निर्वाचन-नोटिस तामिला/1 dated 09.10.2023 has reported that Shri Arvind has neither submitted any 


representation nor any statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the due notice of the 
Election Commission of India, he has furnished neither any reason nor explanation for the said failure; and, 


WHEREAS, the Commission is satisfied that Shri Arvind has failed to lodge the account of election 
expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by 
or under this Act, and 


(b has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and

any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order’’; 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Shri Arvind resident of Village — Jagdishpur, Post - Aoudi, 
District - Ballia, a contesting candidate from 377-Zahoorabad Assembly Constituency of the State of Uttar

or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.

O.N. 44.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Karnataka, 2023 for 125- 
Chikmagaluru Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 
464/KT-LA/2023, dated 13" April, 2023; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him or his election 
agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 125-Chikmagaluru Assembly Constituency of Karnataka, 2023 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 137 May, 2023 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 127 June, 2023; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report of the DEO, Chikmagaluru dated 14.06.2023 under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 
of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Karnataka vide his letter no. DPAR 16 
CHUVEBA (Addl CEO-1) 2023, dated 26.06.2023 stating that B. M. Thimma Shetty, a contesting candidate from 
125-Chikmagaluru Assembly Constituency in General Election to Legislative Assembly of Karnataka, 2023 has 
failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Chikmagaluru a Show-Cause 
Notice No. 76/KT-LA/10/2023/CEMS-II, dated 20" September, 2023 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to B. M. Thimma Shetty, for not lodging of 
the account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961, B. M. Thimma Shetty was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Chikmagaluru District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Chikmagaluru in his report no. E1N(1) CR 57 /2023-24; dated 16.10.2023 has 
reported that the said Show Cause Notice was served to B. M. Thimma Shetty on 24.09.2023; and 


102 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : FEBRUARY 10, 2024/MAGHA 21, 1945 [PART II—SEc. 3(iii)] 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Chikmagaluru in his Supplementary Report vide no. E1N(1) 
CR 57 /2023-24; dated 16.10.2023 on account of the candidate received through CEO, Karnataka letter No. 
DPAR/16/CHUVEBHA (Addl. CEO-1) 2023; dated 16.10.2023, has reported that B. M. Thimma Shetty has not 
submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, B. 
M. Thimma Shetty has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure 
to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 
and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that B. M. Thimma 
Shetty has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure 
to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares B. M. Thimma Shetty, resident of Belawadi (Post) Lakya (Hobli) 
Chikmagalur Taluk and District and a contesting candidate from 125-Chikkamagaluru Assembly Constituency 
of G.E. to LA of Karnataka, 2023, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of 
the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of 
three years from the date of this order.

ORDER 


New Delhi, the 7th Fabruary, 2024 

O.N. 48.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Karnataka, 2023 for 72-Hubballi 
Dharwad East Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 
464/KT-LA/2023, dated 13% April, 2023; and 

WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him or by his election 
agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 

WHEREAS, the result of the election for 72 - Hubballi Dharwad East Assembly Constituency of 
Karnataka, 2023 was declared by the Returning Officer on 13 May, 2023 and hence the last date for lodging the 
account of Election Expenses was 12" June, 2023; and 

WHEREAS, as per the report of the DEO, Dharwad dated 13.06.2023 under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Karnataka vide his letter no. DPAR 09 
CHUVEBA(Addl CEO-1) 2023, dated 26.06.2023 stating that Venkappa F Siddanath, a contesting candidate from 
72 - Hubballi Dharwad East Assembly Constituency in General Election to Legislative Assembly of Karnataka, 
2023 has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 

WHEREAS, on basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Dharwad a Show-Cause notice 
No. 76/KT-LA/10/2023/CEMS-II, dated 13" October, 2023 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Venkappa F Siddanath, for not lodging of the 
account of Election Expenses; and 

WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961, Venkappa F Siddanath was directed to submit representation in writing to the 
Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election 
expenses with the District Election Officer, Dharwad District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; 
and 

WHEREAS, the DEO, Dharwad in his report no. Chunavane/vahi: 10 /2023-24; dated 08.11.2023 has 
reported that the said Show Cause Notice was served to Venkappa F Siddanath on 17.10.2023; and 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(iii)] भारत का राजपत्र : फरवरी 10, 2024/माघ 21, 1945 111 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Dharwad in his Supplementary Report dated 08.11.2023 
received through CEO, Karnataka vide letter No. DPAR/09/Chuvebha(Addl.CEO-1) 2023; dated 09.11.2023 on 
account of the candidate has reported that Venkappa F Siddanath has not submitted any representation or statement 
of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Venkappa F Siddanath has neither 
furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to lodge the account of his 
election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 

“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 

(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act; and 

(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 


and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 

WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Venkappa F 
Siddanath has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the 
failure to do so; and 

NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Venkappa F Siddanath, resident of Prajwal Building, 2" floor, Near 
Shyandil Ashram, Dayanand Colony, Hubballi, TQ-Hubballi, Dist-Dharwad and a contesting candidate in 
72 - Hubballi Dharwad East Assembly Constituency of G.E. to LA of Karnataka, 2023, to be disqualified for being 
chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative 
Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.
